## Implementation (as landed)

- `db/src/db/claim_sink.py`: `DuplicateBatch` (conn, run_id, existing digest→claim_id,
  capture_by_digest, `replay` flag) + `record_resightings(batch)` — the production
  `on_duplicates` hook. One `claim_evidence` `establishes` row per re-sighted claim to
  the execution's own per-(source, genre, run) capture, via the same `_LINK_EVIDENCE`
  statement (`ON CONFLICT (claim_id, capture_id, role) DO NOTHING`) — inside the chunk
  transaction, uncapped, unfiltered, and `+0` when the same capture re-asserts
  (resume/re-flush). `batch.replay` (the sink's `is_replay`) returns early: a replay
  re-reads stored bytes; it is not a source sighting.
- `connectors/src/connectors/sinks.py`: `make_claim_sink('pg')` sets
  `on_duplicates=record_resightings` alongside `object_resolver=record_object_ref`
  (both still overridable). The asserting `replay_ingest` path builds its sink
  directly — no hook — so replay never writes sighting links.
- `ops/src/ops/cli.py` `sink-bench`: passes `on_duplicates=record_resightings` so the
  bench exercises the true production write path (its +0 pass is now also a bounded
  `claim_evidence` growth measurement).
- `reconcile/src/reconcile/materialize.py`: capture-time fallback joins
  `max(ec2.retrieved_at)` (LATEST sighting; was `min`); basis constant
  `capture_retrieved_at_latest`; flush calls `close_superseded_resolutions` once per
  batch before inserting — closes live `auto` rows whose input_digest changed,
  skips+counts pairs blocked by a live non-auto decision; summary gains
  `superseded`/`skipped_pinned`; `read_materialized_resolutions` returns only
  `upper_inf(sys_period)` (current) rows.
- `reconcile/src/reconcile/resolve.py`: `observed_at_basis` docstring updated;
  resolver already labelled the basis in `rules_fired`.
- sqitch `resolution_supersede`: `SECURITY DEFINER close_superseded_resolutions
  (uuid[], text[], text[])` — owner-run so `sig_materialize` keeps INSERT-only on
  `resolution` (verified: no UPDATE/DELETE grant); closes only live
  `decided_by='auto'` rows whose digest differs; live non-auto rows report 'blocked'.
  `unnest()` unqualified (the `pg_catalog.`-qualified multi-array form fails to
  resolve — found by `make test-db`).

## Test matrix (all green)

- `tests/db/test_resightings.py` (6, real PG): unchanged re-ingest +links/+0 claims;
  same capture re-flush +0 links; three distinct captures → three links; A → B → A
  resolves to A with `capture_retrieved_at_latest` in `rules_fired`; supersession
  closes the prior `sys_period` and the new row wins; a human (`non-auto`) decision
  blocks and is counted, never overridden; no UPDATE/DELETE path.
- `tests/db/test_resolution_materialize.py`, `tests/connectors/test_partner_refs_shadow.py`
  adjusted for the new summary fields.
- `make check`: ruff + format + mypy (255 files) + pytest + verify-gen — see below.
- `make test-db` (`SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`, PG18+PostGIS testcontainer): **258 passed**.

See VERIFICATION.md. Headlines:

- **Schema:** `sqitch deploy` over cloud-sql-proxy landed `partner_org_identity_key`
  (owed since P31.5) + `resolution_supersede`, verified.
- **Images (digest-pinned, never `:latest`):**
  ingest `sig-api:p31-7-062306e70d3d` → `sha256:6ad5477d…f5` (build 5903cb4f, 87 s);
  materialize `sig-api:materialize-062306e70d3d` → `sha256:959c40c6…d5` (build 8f94714a, 58 s).
- **Roll:** `roll-jobs --apply` rolled + verified **70 jobs** to `6ad5477d…`;
  `sig-ingest-camreg-batch-05` excluded and confirmed still on `feff986c…`;
  `sig-sink-bench` updated to `6ad5477d…`; `sig-materialize` on `959c40c6…`.
- **Bounded link-volume measurement** (Cloud Run `sig-sink-bench-pxgq9`, real source
  `camreg_fl511_fl`, 2 passes next to the DB):
  pass 1 — 128,383 records: +12,335 claims, 103,713 duplicates → **+116,048 links**;
  pass 2 — +0 claims, 116,048 duplicates → **+116,048 links** (a second distinct
  capture; same-capture +0 proven by the PK in the real-PG tests).
  `claim_evidence` 2,391,551 → 2,623,647 rows; table+indexes 357,752,832 →
  406,708,224 B (**+48,955,392 B ≈ 210.9 B/link**); DB 4,776,916,671 → 4,833,670,847 B.
  `n_tup_upd`/`n_tup_del` = 0 on `claim`, `claim_evidence`, `resolution`.
- **Disk:** `dataDiskSizeGb` read live = **15 GB** PD-SSD (autoresize on; ADR-107).
  DB 4.83 GB ≈ 32% of 15 GB; ≈ 48% vs the operator's 10 GB comparison.
- **Resolution materialization** (`sig-materialize`, role `sig_materialize`):
  first run `sig-materialize-bnq5m` (65 min) — 1,965,997 pairs, **203,786** new
  decision rows, 1,732,911 unchanged, **139,433** live auto decisions superseded,
  0 pinned, 0 duplicate live pairs. Re-run `sig-materialize-mdfpm` (exit 0):
  **+0** — inserted/superseded/skipped_pinned 0, skipped_existing 1,936,697 =
  every live row. (A first re-run attempt `…-9jlgv` died on a Cloud SQL
  connection reset; rollback verified, no partial writes.) Full table:
  VERIFICATION.md.
- **12-month projection:** ~2.5M links/month upper bound (every claim re-sighted once
  per its cadence: 63 monthly + 6 weekly + 1 quarterly jobs; OSM monthly dominates at
  ~1.37M) ≈ ~530 MB/month → ~6.4 GB in 12 months — 43% of 15 GB (below the 50%
  trigger) but 64% of the 10 GB comparison (crosses it in ~9–10 months) — recorded in
  ADR-114's revisit trigger.
